description: This source file defines multiple Orleans Grains (FirstGrain, SecondGrain, ThirdGrain) along with a serializable state class ThirdGrainState. It contains grain methods that perform asynchronous calls to other grains, demonstrating coordination and concurrency control for testing reentrancy and correlation ID handling.

classes.name: FirstGrain
classes.description: A grain that initiates calls to SecondGrain instances and waits for their completion.

classes.name: SecondGrain
classes.description: A grain that makes parallel calls to ThirdGrain instances and waits for all to complete.

classes.name: ThirdGrainState
classes.description: A serializable state class for ThirdGrain, empty in this implementation.

classes.name: ThirdGrain
classes.description: A grain that manages a counter for in-flight calls to ensure only one call at a time, throws exception if concurrent calls occur.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initiates concurrent calls to SecondGrain methods with specified GUIDs.

methods.name: SecondGrainMethod
methods.description: Makes parallel calls to ThirdGrain instances passing a GUID.

methods.name: ThirdGrainMethod
methods.description: Performs concurrency control, increments a counter, throws if multiple calls are in-flight, and writes state.
